before-starting-below-ice-mountain.text: He doesn't seem too interested in talking to you.

after-completing-below-ice-mountain-in-n.player: Wow, the desert really suits you Marley.

after-completing-below-ice-mountain-in-n.npc: [player name] my old pal! How are you doing?

after-completing-below-ice-mountain-in-n.player: Better now I don't have to deal with you. Enjoying life in the desert?

after-completing-below-ice-mountain-in-n.npc: Not really. I'm not suited to such harsh climates. No steak sandwiches here either...

after-completing-below-ice-mountain-in-n.player: Oh what a shame! Poor Marley's going to starve as he doesn't have anyone to make his sandwiches... So sad.
